lines.en: Here you go, Phoebs.
Who else wants one of my special homemade brownies?
I will have one.
Yeah, I'm not going to have one.
No, no, it's just my tooth.
All right, I'll have another tooth.
So what's the matter? You need a dentist? I've got a good one.
Oh, thanks. I have a good one, too. I just, I, I can't see him.
See, that is the problem with invisible dentists.
Why? Why can't you go to him?
Because every time I go to the dentist, somebody dies.
That is so weird, because every time I go to the dentist, I look down the hygienist's blouse.
Phoebe, what, um, what?
Yeah, yeah, first there was my Aunt Mary, and then there was John, my mailman,
and then my, my cowboy friend, Albino Bob.
And all of these people actually died?
Yes, while I was in the chair.
That's why I take such good care of my teeth now, you know?
It's not about oral hygiene. I flossed to save lives.
Phoebs, come on, you didn't kill anybody.
These people just happened to die when you went to the dentist.
It's, it's just a coincidence.
Well, tell that to them.
